# SocialStudio AI
> AI LinkedIn Carousel & Visual Hook Studio for Creators and B2B Founders

SocialStudio AI converts ideas, raw notes, and articles into viral LinkedIn carousels, PDF slide decks, and companion X/Twitter threads in 30 seconds.

## Core Capabilities
- **Viral Frameworks**: Story Arc, Step-by-Step, Myth vs Fact, Contrarian Take, Listicle.
- **Visual Design Themes**: Modern Minimal, Dark Tech, Bold Gradient, Editorial Classic, Neo Brutalist, Emerald Growth, Crimson Bold, Nordic Frost.
- **Instant Client-Side Vector PDF**: Generates 1080x1350 (4:5) and 1080x1080 (1:1) crisp vector PDFs ready for LinkedIn document upload.
- **Companion Threads**: Auto-generates matching Twitter/X threads to cross-post and double audience reach.
- **Self-Serve Monetization**: Free interactive preview with no signup wall, Creator Starter Pack ($9 for 35 generations), Founder Lifetime Deal ($49 one-time), and BYOK ($29 LTD).

## Technical Architecture
- Framework: Next.js 14 App Router + TailwindCSS + Lucide Icons
- LLM Intelligence: Google Gemini 1.5 Pro / Flash with structured JSON output and strict fallback
- Document Rendering: Vector client-side PDF rendering with jsPDF
- Monetization: Stripe Checkout + Webhook verification with idempotent deduplication
- Database: SQLite / PostgreSQL via Prisma ORM
- Edge Rate Limiting: Sliding window token limiter on API endpoints
